questions.question: Which statement best describes biodiversity?

options.text: The variety of living organisms and their relationships
Only the number of animal species

questions.explanation: Biodiversity includes variation within species, between species and across ecosystems.

questions.question: Why is classification useful in biology?

options.text: It organises organisms and supports comparison
It removes the need for scientific names
It proves all organisms are identical

questions.explanation: Classification provides a consistent way to organise, identify and compare organisms.
